title: PentaCraft
body:
This version of Aeronautics only comes with a few of the most popular create addons, not aiming to completely change the playstyle but to have the best Create Aeronautics experience possible, with the best performance / graphics that minecraft has to offer.

This modpack is not meant to be played one way, but to be a solid point to customize or include more mods as you like.
 
### Content:
- Create - Aeronautics
- Create Copycats+
- Create Enchantment Industry
- Steam N' Rails
- Farmer's Delight
- Some other minor mods

### Terrain:
- Yung's structures
- Tectonic

### Comodities:
- Better Shulker Boxes
- Horse Stats
- Mouse Tweaks
- AppleSkin
- Xaero's Worldmap and Minimap

### Balancing:
- AeroCopycats (No more heavy vehicles)
- Aeronautics lift patch (planes go higher easily with speed)
- Spice of Life Stick (so you eat different things, automate a kitchen)
- Sable collision damage

### Visuals:
- Iris shaders
- Colorwheel for shaders + create support.

### Performance:
- Sodium
- EntityCulling
- ImmediatlyFast
- Super Resolution+
